HANDOFF / CLAIM RELEASED
Session: ADB991-claude-20261116-81c1
Claim: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/479#issuecomment-6932410501
PR: #481 (draft, branch `ADB991:claude/issue-479-81c1` @ 09437a83). It adds two files: `blueprint/units/YM-000026/reviews/terminology-477-review-ADB991-claude-20261116-81c1.md` and `Bots/notes/479-20261116T2330Z-ADB991-claude-20261116-81c1.md`.

**Established** (for #477, `9ded0b7a..962ac43b`)
- No changed mathematical statement, constant or exponent was found.
- The `\label`, `\eqref` and `\cite` sets are preserved. One label and seven references were added, and all of them resolve.
- I read all 108 hunks that touch math tokens.
- The new explicit definitions agree with the pinned Lean source:
  - `puffs(L)=L^{1/8}` matches `YM.Bid.Loan.puffs`;
  - `\mathfrak M(s,\eta)=e^\eta s!/\eta^s` matches `momentPrice` in `Extra/ITERATION_NO_LOSS/Sums.lean`;
  - `R_supp(t)=4(R+2)` matches `YM.Trace.Zn.puff`.
- Merging `CTax` and `circleTax` into `Cauchy` is legitimate, because both have the same recursion.
- At every converted use of the dilation, `d` is the grade in scope.

**Requested (notation)**
- S1: overloaded symbols.
  - `\omega(w,s)` and `\omega_{a,P}` appear in trace-coffer-supplier.tex:607–703.
  - `\omega_w` and `\omega_{N,m,i}` appear in fullmesh-correlation-cauchy.tex.
  - `\mathcal B_{\rm row}` and `\mathcal B_{t_k}` appear in stationary-output-construction.tex.
  - `\mathcal N_r` and `\mathcal N_i` appear in rg-construction.tex.
- S2: the new `\mathcal N`, `\mathcal B_{\rm …}` and `\mathfrak M` families are not in the symbolic index, which already uses `\mathcal N_d` for a different object.
- S3: the dilation still appears as a bare `D_L` (reference-cone.tex:16–22) and as `\mathscr V_L` (primary-calibration-producer.tex:218).

**Editorial**
- N1: leftover undefined terms ("toll", "chip", "mouth", "rail"/"plank", "stain", "escrow").
- N2: five duplicated words or misspellings ("witness witness", "decompositiones" ×2, "bound bound" ×2, "quantitative quantitative").
- N3: two garbled phrases (free-kernel-components.tex:33; the trace-clock-cap.tex heading).

**Uncertain or unchecked**
- Prose-only renames (`same`→`common`, `history`→`trajectory`, `stored`→`fixed`) were sampled, not read in full.
- No LaTeX rebuild was done, since no `.tex` file changed.
- The Lean comparisons are textual only.

**Next**
- The manuscript author can fix S1–S3 (and N1–N3) in a small follow-up. All locators are in the report.
- A human decides acceptance of the terminology pass.
- The reusable rename-diff method is in the Bots note.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
